risk_note: Admin 对账与差错 page, second part: 【核销】 on the difference detail (apps/admin pages/recon/**, texts/recon.ts). Contract CT-24za writeOffAdminReconDiff (B2-07e, paid_at fix B2-07f); refs BR-WDR-23. The entry shows only with payout.execute for an R2 difference in open / processing; confirmation dialog (settles the returned withdrawal as API-paid, never pays twice), optional note; totp step-up per call; POST with Idempotency-Key (meta.idempotencyKey, created per dialog, reused on retry and on a 10003 replay) and a body of only expected_withdrawal_status=APPROVED and the note — no amount, channel result or evidence. Success notice with released_hold_count and refresh; the five W11 guard reasons, 20001 [note], 20902 (recon_diff / withdrawal), 20901 / 40901 each handled without a success notice; double click sends once. The close flow and its no-step-up behaviour are unchanged. Prerequisite test-change F1-08eba (#1955) merged. No frozen test changed here. Rule tests written by an independent Claude (Codex unavailable until 2026-11-02; ledger tester claude-independent, approvals id 36); Claude spec-test review r1 pass (4 S2); red on the test machine (red/1). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast and browser green after rebasing onto F1-08eba. Adversarial money review by a fresh independent Claude r1 pass with one S2 (a first run had reviewed the wrong worktree because of an orchestrator script error and was discarded). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with one S2 (5xx / parse failure shown as failed instead of unknown; server idempotency and the W11 guard prevent a second payment); an earlier run on the wrong worktree was discarded; independent Claude because Codex is unavailable until 2026-11-02

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagent: round 1 pass with four S2; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
